text:
Kelley Jones named to 2026 Bronko Nagurski Trophy preseason watch list
L. R. Harper
Mississippi State cornerback Kelley Jones has been named to the 2026 Bronko Nagurski Trophy Preseason Watch List, the Football Writers Association of America announced on Aug. 4.
The Bronko Nagurski Trophy is awarded annually by the Football Writers Association of America to the top defensive player in college football. The preseason watch list includes standout defensive players from across the country, with finalists scheduled to be announced in November and the winner unveiled in December.
Jones, a native of Clarksdale, Mississippi, enters the upcoming season following a breakout second year where he appeared in 11 games with four starts and recorded 29 tackles. Last season, he earned a primary starting role and received postseason recognition, including All-SEC honors, while establishing himself as one of the conference's premier lockdown defensive backs.
The Bronko Nagurski Trophy has been presented by the association since 1993. In 1995, it was named after Pro Football Hall of Famer Bronislaw "Bronko" Nagurski. Committee members will continue monitoring candidates throughout the fall and may add weekly honorees before selecting finalists later in the year.
For more information about Mississippi State football updates and news regarding Jones or other players, fans are encouraged to follow MSU football on social media platforms under "HailStateFB."
